title: 29 PLA aircraft and Chinese vessels around Taiwan; 23 cross median line
detail: Taiwan's defense ministry reported 29 Chinese military aircraft and navy vessels around Taiwan in a 24-hour window, with 23 aircraft crossing the median line. Since the start of October Taiwan has detected 163 Chinese military aircraft and 252 naval units. Reporting rests on a single secondary outlet; the figures are not independently confirmed here.

media.caption: China sends 29 military aircraft to the Taiwan Strait
